text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Tch,
it's no use. I can't concentrate at
all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I've thought up a new algorithm, but I
just can't
bring myself to flesh it out.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I realize that it's most efficient to
just do the work
regardless of my motivation. I
know that, and yet,
I just...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Well, whatever. I'll just jot the idea
down for now
and crunch the numbers
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like the fatigue from Air
Shakur's 
back-to-back races is catching up to her.
This might call for some adjustments to
her race schedule.
